# main.py
import os
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from agent.core_planner import process_user_message

app = FastAPI(title="Agentic Backend - TFM Javier")

class Message(BaseModel):
    role: str
    content: str

class ChatReq(BaseModel):
    model: str
    messages: List[Message]

@app.post("/v1/chat/completions")
async def completions(payload: ChatReq):
    # Convert messages to simple text (or keep structure)
    last_msg = payload.messages[-1].content
    result = await process_user_message(payload.messages)
    # Return OpenAI compatible response for Open WebUI
    return {
        "id": "cmpl-1",
        "object": "chat.completion",
        "choices": [
            {"index": 0, "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": result.get("final_answer", result)}}
        ]
    }

# Tools endpoints (for direct invocation if needed)
from fastapi import Body

@app.post("/tools/influx_query")
async def influx_tool(payload: Dict = Body(...)):
    from agent.tools.influx_agent import InfluxDBAgent
    agent = InfluxDBAgent()
    return agent.run(payload)
